description: Expose a Connect RPC `MeasuresService.ValidateScenario`; add a test-genie `measures` phase that shells the validate verb and maps results to a new `FINDING_SOURCE_MEASURES`; introduce a soft `measures` dimension in the EM ladder dimensions SSOT gated at a soft rung (R3/R4) so a scenario remains runnable without measures but cannot reach top maturity without full coverage.

requirements.description: Expose a proto-first Connect RPC `MeasuresService.ValidateScenario` that accepts a scenario name and returns the same structured coverage report produced by the CLI validate verb. The CLI command must be implemented as a thin shell over this RPC. The RPC must be defined in a .proto file and the Connect handler must delegate to the same validator logic used by the CLI, ensuring CLI and API are consistent.
requirements.title: MeasuresService.ValidateScenario Connect RPC Endpoint

validation.notes: Go unit test: ValidateScenario RPC handler returns the same coverage report structure as the CLI validate function for a fixture scenario
Go unit test: RPC handler returns gRPC/Connect NOT_FOUND status for an unknown scenario name

Boot the measures-health API; call MeasuresService.ValidateScenario via Connect client for a fixture scenario; assert response matches the expected JSON shape with expected/covered/waived/tier/verdict fields
Shell `measures-health validate scenario <name> --json` and call MeasuresService.ValidateScenario for the same scenario; assert both outputs are semantically identical
ValidateScenario RPC responds within 5 seconds for a single scenario
Proto file is the single source of truth for the response shape; CLI output is derived from proto marshalling, not a separate struct

requirements.description: Add a `measures` phase to test-genie that shells `measures-health validate scenario <name> --json` and maps the results to a new `FINDING_SOURCE_MEASURES` finding source. Introduce a soft `measures` dimension in the EM ladder dimensions SSOT, gated at a soft rung (R3/R4), such that a scenario remains runnable without measures coverage but cannot reach top maturity (R5+) without full coverage. The EM ladder must treat missing measures coverage as a soft gate, not a hard blocker for execution.
requirements.title: Test-Genie Measures Phase and EM Ladder Measures Dimension

validation.notes: Go unit test: test-genie measures phase correctly parses `measures-health validate scenario --json` stdout and maps ERROR findings to FINDING_SOURCE_MEASURES findings
Go unit test: EM ladder dimension calculator returns a rung below R5 for a scenario with zero measures coverage, and returns R5 for a scenario with full coverage
Go unit test: EM ladder allows a scenario with no measures to be executed (runnable=true) but sets maturity_blocked=true with reason MEASURES_COVERAGE_INCOMPLETE
Run test-genie measures phase against a fixture scenario with full measures coverage; assert FINDING_SOURCE_MEASURES findings list is empty and EM rung is R5
Run test-genie measures phase against a fixture scenario with zero measures coverage; assert at least one FINDING_SOURCE_MEASURES finding is present and EM rung is below R5
Assert that a scenario with no measures passes test-genie execution phase but its EM ladder report shows soft gate blocked at R3/R4 boundary
EM ladder dimensions SSOT file contains the `measures` dimension entry with soft_rung=R3 (or R4 as configured) and is the single authoritative source for all EM rung calculators

title: Producer Wiring into EM Maturity Ladder
